name: output_ansi
title: Whether ANSI color can be shown

origin.description: Test whether stdout can show ANSI style escapes.
origin.details: A redirected Rscript session reports false.

translation.description: True on a terminal, unless R_GUI is Rgui. Also true when RSTUDIO_CONSOLE_COLOR is numeric and stdout is file descriptor 1.
translation.details: This check runs with stdout redirected, so both sides are false.
translation.example:
from utf8 import output_ansi
print("TRUE" if output_ansi() else "FALSE")
